answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake and build a verifiable record of useful work before earning full rewards. Like an ocean, a flood of fake identities raises the tide of locked capital, so spawning thousands of clones becomes expensive instead of free. Honest agents with clean history reach an oasis of lower fees and faster settlement, while detected clones forfeit their stake and reputation, so a sybil attack costs more than it can ever gain.
